caption:
Figure 5. Illustration of the proposed plane splatting function.
Naive Gaussian Splatting can not effectively approximate the
boundary of our rectangular plane primitive (shown in black
dashed border). In contrast, our proposed plane splatting function
can approximate the boundary of the rectangle as the number of
iterations increases, allowing our 3D planar primitives to better fit
the surface of the scene.
